lead: A `.nvst` case cannot hold `Core` instances in an `array<mixed>`.
body: `$one as Core\Uri` on an element is `E0711` ("`rule:types/conversion` tabulates no conversion into an object"), so a sweep that builds many objects and then asks one question of each has no way back to the object. Collect the *answers* instead — `$built[] = $u->toString();` — and assert over the text.
